# UniDownloader 1.0.1
- Rebranded YTDLP Glass as UniDownloader while retaining the update-compatible bundle identifier for existing users. - Replaced the menu-bar scene with a stable native status item, eliminating the macOS Tahoe update loop that could leave the app unresponsive. - Drag a browser URL directly over the menu-bar arrow: the drop zone opens automatically and starts the download with the chosen folder and options. - Added a green menu-bar progress indicator and a right-click menu with Open, Settings, and Quit. - Added a Settings gear in the main toolbar and made the sidebar Drop Zone item functional. - Added first-launch welcome guidance covering use, privacy, local data, and updates. - App updates now check at launch and Sparkle presents the release notes before installation. Automatic downloads remain available in Settings. - Retains bundled Apple Silicon FFmpeg/FFprobe, verified yt-dlp runtime updates, and YouTube/Instagram compatibility safeguards.

# YTDLP Glass 1.0.0
- Native Apple Silicon media downloader with a Tahoe Liquid Glass interface. - Fixed quick-options bar, persistent download folders, and menu bar drag-and-drop downloads. - Bundled native Apple Silicon FFmpeg/FFprobe plus YouTube and Instagram compatibility improvements. - Fixed a macOS 26 scene-update loop so the main window and menu bar remain responsive. - Signed automatic app updates through Sparkle and verified yt-dlp engine updates.
